detail.longDescription: Anthropic and OpenAI should give Stack Overflow a percentage of their company. They used all of Stack Overflow's data to train their AI models at the beginning of LLMs without paying for it because it was publicly available online. ChatGPT and Claude would not exist today without the 24 million coding questions and 36 million answers with code examples included, all created by real humans who took the time to write the questions and answers. Stack Overflow deserves to be rewarded for making Anthropic and OpenAI such a success. And all the developers who posted and answered questions on Stack Overflow should be given stock too.
